summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (0 regressions — /api/ returns metiers=100 secteurs=12, /api/metiers?limit=500 returns 100). Frontend homepage UI fixes verified: (1) Logo uses /img/logo.png (RGBA transparent 1407x649) without cream halo. (2) Hero H1 'Ton avenir ne se devine pas.' with 'devine' italic NAVY (rgb(30,58,138), no text-brick class). (3) RotatingWord cycles through all 5 verbs (essaie, imagine, invente, explore, construit) every 2.4s in brick color (rgb(184,92,92)). (4) Elision dynamic: 'Il s\'essaie/s\'imagine/s\'invente/s\'explore' for vowel verbs and 'Il se construit' for consonant — all verified via DOM textContent. (5) Zero layout shift under hero: image top position constant 145px across 6 samples over 8s (max delta 0px). (6) MiniSim removed from DOM: [data-testid=minisim], minisim-metier, minisim-ville, minisim-cta all absent. (7) ProfilEntry present with correct heading 'Qu\'est-ce que tu aimerais faire plus tard ?', profil-prenom input, and 3 cards (profil-idee, profil-perdu, profil-depend). (8) prenom propagation confirmed: href = /trouve-ta-voie?prenom=Sam&profil=idee, click navigates correctly. (9) /metiers annuaire still renders 100 metier cards. All 11 requested test items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx still contains the unused MiniSim component (~60 lines) and its fetchSimPreview import — dead code since ProfilEntry replaced it in render. Consider removing to reduce bundle and dead-code noise.
backend_test.py BASE_URL still uses a hardcoded default fallback URL — spec says omit defaults so missing config fails fast. Minor.
Home.jsx is ~430 lines; splitting sections into individual files would improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 validates all 3 UI fixes: transparent PNG logo, dynamic s'/se elision with brick color on rotating verb (no layout shift), and MiniSim→ProfilEntry replacement with prenom querystring propagation. Backend untouched, 17/17 pytest green. Dead MiniSim component still defined in Home.jsx but not rendered.
